visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a minimalist digital animation style, a round blue cat-like character with black stripes known as Bugcat Capoo sits on a plain white floor next to a tall stack of white paper. In front of Capoo is a small plastic tray containing four colorful paint tubes in red, yellow, and green. Capoo opens its large mouth unnaturally wide and consumes the entire box of paints in a single, swift motion. (2) Capoo is shown in a medium close-up shot, holding a large red paint tube with both of its small blue paws. The character displays a joyful facial expression with a wide, red mouth and small, twinkling black eyes. The background remains a completely featureless white void, focusing the viewer's attention entirely on the character's vibrant blue body and the contrasting red object it holds. (3) The scene shifts as Capoo takes on a determined and somewhat angry facial expression with downward-slanted eyebrows and a small frown. It squeezes the red paint tube forcefully with both paws, causing bright red paint to splatter messily onto the white paper below. A box of other colored tubes sits open and slightly discarded to the right side of the frame. (4) Capoo is now seen holding a miniature version of a red cat-like character, using it as a specialized drawing tool. Golden sparkles and stars erupt around Capoo as it looks ecstatic with its mouth wide open in a laugh. The lighting is bright and perfectly even, characteristic of high-quality 2D vector animation style. (5) Capoo lies happily on its stomach, using the small red character-pen to draw a detailed red sketch on the top sheet of paper. A small red snail-like creature with a white face and a shell made of sushi lies dormant on the right. Scraps of crumpled white paper are scattered around the work area, indicating a long creative process. (6) A simple yellow dog character enters the frame from the left side, grabs the finished red drawing with its mouth, and quickly exits. Capoo's expression changes instantly from focused to shocked, with wide white eyes and a sweat drop appearing on its head. It immediately stands up and begins to chase the dog off-screen. (7) Capoo interacts with a human female character named Lala, who has short red hair and wears a white tank top with yellow shorts. Capoo offers her a large brown fried chicken leg held in its mouth. Lala holds a piece of paper and smiles warmly with a pink heart icon appearing above Capoo, indicating affection. (8) Transitioning to a new performance setting, Capoo stands on a wooden stage framed by large red velvet curtains. In front of the stage, a dense crowd of pink-colored silhouettes is seen from the back, cheering and holding up cameras to take photos. A large gold-framed empty picture is displayed prominently behind Capoo on the stage wall. (9) Capoo is shown lying comfortably on its back atop a massive, overflowing pile of green paper money. It holds its red character-marker and looks extremely content with closed eyes and a small, peaceful smile. A few green banknotes float in the air around the character's blue body, suggesting a recent windfall of wealth. (10) Capoo pushes a silver shopping cart piled high with thick stacks of green money toward Lala, who is sitting at a desk using a digital drawing tablet. Lala turns around and her face contorts into an expression of extreme shock with a wide mouth and tiny eyes. A framed picture of a cat hangs on the wall behind her. (11) The final scene depicts Capoo sleeping soundly on a circular yellow cushion, a small pink heart floating above its head. The red snail character is visible on the left side of the frame. The text 'BUGCAT CAPOO' appears in clean, gray sans-serif capital letters at the bottom center of the screen.
